name: ChartContainer
description: The theming bridge for a chart somebody else draws: a Box that declares `--chart-1` … `--chart-6` in both themes plus one `--color-<series>` per series, so a Recharts `<Line stroke="var(--color-revenue)">` names no colour of its own and its dark mode belongs to the page.

props.name: series
props.description: The series drawn inside, and what colour each of them is.

a11y: It is a `<div>` with variables on it — no role, no name, nothing in the accessibility tree. Whatever the chart library renders inside owns its own accessibility.
